new_test_protocol.task: Frozen-controller prospective flexible appendage confirmation and stress tests
new_test_protocol.selection: all nine previously fixed controllers; no test-driven selection or changes

observation_noise.distribution: independent zero-mean Gaussian per scene, component and sample

acceptance.absorption: failure freezes state, zero subsequent torque

new_test_protocol.policy_inputs: measured four states, own integral, previous sent command, elapsed time; no frequency/damping

primary.interval: two-sided paired cluster percentile bootstrap; simultaneous Bonferroni
primary.clusters: 128 independent initial states; each cluster contains all five frequencies
primary.superiority: each of three seeds has lower CI>0 against BOTH references, evaluated separately for each group
primary.zero_physical_failure_claim: reported separately, not silently inferred from success fraction

secondary.interval: same paired clusters; separate simultaneous Bonferroni family
secondary.cost_advantage_requires: both methods succeed in all 640 episodes and cost-difference upper CI<0
secondary.other_metrics: full-angle RMS, peak relative angle and frequency summaries descriptive

new_test_protocol.scope: single-axis two-inertia one-mode numerical model; ideal torque source; measured flexure assumed; no flight/hardware validation
